tasks.label: Check git and GitHub CLI
tasks.command: Get-Command git,gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source; Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Name,Mode; Get-ChildItem -Force .\data | Select-Object Name,Mode

tasks.label: Initialize and commit StatSkripsi
tasks.command: git init; git add .gitignore README.md app.R data/contoh.csv .vscode/tasks.json; git status --short; git commit -m "Initial commit: StatSkripsi data analysis app"
